title: Ohm Brew Double Brew Raspberry Watermelon 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Ohm Brew Double Brew Raspberry Watermelon is a study in contrasts that works beautifully. The profile begins with the sharp, slightly sour tang of wild Raspberry, waking up the senses. This is immediately smoothed over by the aqueous, mellow sweetness of Watermelon, creating a balanced vape that is both zesty and refreshing. Formulated with a balanced 50% VG / 50% PG ratio, this e-liquid is versatile enough for both MTL (Mouth-to-Lung) and RDL (Restricted Direct-to-Lung) vaping. It pairs perfectly with coils ranging from 1.2ohm to 0.6ohm, ensuring consistent flavour and vapour production. The nicotine salt formula ensures a smooth throat hit and rapid satisfaction. Double Brew by the renowned UK mixologists Ohm Brew is a collection of double-concentrated nicotine salts designed to deliver maximum flavour intensity. Known as "bar salts," these e-liquids are formulated with twice the flavour concentrate of standard blends, offering an intensely bold and vivid taste profile. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg strengths, Double Brew provides a smooth and satisfying vape experience.
